steps.title: Clone the repo
steps.detail: Anywhere you like. Everything machine-specific goes into one git-ignored file, team.config.json, so nothing in the repo has your paths in it.

steps.title: Say the sentence
steps.detail: Open the folder in Claude Code or T3 Code and paste the setup sentence. That thread reads BOOTSTRAP.md and becomes your project manager.

steps.title: Let it check your machine
steps.detail: It looks for git, Node, Python, an NVIDIA GPU and disk space, and tells you exactly what's missing before it installs anything.

steps.title: Connect or install ComfyUI
steps.detail: Point it at an existing ComfyUI, or let it install one with the models the workflows need. A fresh install needs a free Hugging Face account and your go-ahead for the download.

steps.title: Meet the team
steps.detail: The project manager opens five more threads: Research, Concept, Front-end, Backend and Review. Each runs a quick self-test and reports in.

steps.title: Give it a prompt
steps.detail: One sentence about the website you want. From there, you're asked four times. Everything in between is the team's job.

faq.q: Do I need an NVIDIA GPU?
faq.a: Yes. The kit generates its imagery locally in ComfyUI and is tuned for an NVIDIA card with 12 GB of video memory. It isn't suited to machines without one.

faq.q: Which agents does it run on?
faq.a: Claude Code or T3 Code. The project manager is the thread you start; it creates the other five.

faq.q: Do I have to make every decision?
faq.a: Only four: strategy, creative direction, design, and release. The team prepares each one as a packet with options and a recommendation, and you can always say "revise".

faq.q: Can I use the images commercially?
faq.a: Shipped images come only from commercially licensed workflows, and every image keeps its prompt, model and licence beside it. FLUX Klein's licence allows commercial use for businesses under US$5M in annual revenue; the credits page says what applies.

faq.q: Where does my work end up?
faq.a: In your repo. Each website is a folder under projects/, with its brief, research, concepts, gate decisions and code, all as plain files you can read.

faq.q: What if I don't like any of the options?
faq.a: Say "revise" and what's wrong. The round happens inside the same gate; nothing moves on until you say yes.
